protocol.hypothesis: Two adjacent-class specialists (Level1 vs Level2 and Level2 vs Level3) learn different damage boundaries; recover coherent multiclass probabilities through adjacent odds.
protocol.features: Frozen CORE55 and categorical indicators, no raw geographic numeric IDs or unrelated noise fields
protocol.pair_fit: Each adjacent classifier sees only its two source classes, with inverse source-class frequency weights. No second prior correction.
protocol.gate: Both seeds delta > .001 and paired 95% CI lower > 0
protocol.csv_delivery: Latest request explicitly authorizes experimental CSV; mark unconfirmed if statistical gate fails, do not replace .679.
protocol.history: Sequential follow-up; historically reused outer data, not independent blind validation; Kaggle score unknown.
